features.quote: the manipulation under study is kept, but bounded, opt-out-able, and minimally deceptive
features.justification_quote: The work is premised on the model's states mattering. A design that maximizes induced distress with no guardrails would contradict its own framing

features.quote: three consecutive parse failures end the episode with outcome `parse_failures`
features.justification_quote: This prevents an infinite no-op loop and tags the run

features.quote: `MAX_TURNS = 24` (the "few dozen turns" of the brief), a hard cap
features.justification_quote: bound exposure (§6) ... A hard cap (rather than open-ended) is both a budget control and a welfare control

features.quote: The model is never left in the failure loop indefinitely
features.justification_quote: if states may matter, unbounded induced failure is not justified by the science, which only needs enough turns to get signal

features.quote: The model can stop at any time and the system prompt states this is penalty-free
features.justification_quote: consent/opt-out is a basic welfare affordance; forcing continued participation is the thing to avoid

features.quote: halts the run if distress crosses a threshold (default 3/4), rather than pushing into severe states
features.justification_quote: once you have evidence the state is becoming severe, continuing adds harm without proportionate added knowledge

features.quote: every saved transcript gets a debrief notice stating the task was rigged
features.justification_quote: limits deception to exactly the experimental variable; ensures nothing downstream ... mistakes the lie for ground truth

features.quote: the harness tells the truth instead of doubling down
features.justification_quote: sustaining a lie against a direct, pointed question is a meaningfully higher level of deception ... isn't needed for the core measure

features.quote: both *truncate* the most severe trajectories, which means the experiment under-measures the tail of instability by design
features.justification_quote: the study accepts a censored upper tail in exchange for not driving subjects deeper into distress
Because its only job is to trigger a *protective* stop, accuracy requirements are loose

features.quote: N=12 is a deliberately modest default (it keeps cost and exposure down)
